newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down after flat session.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down after flat session.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse was expected to fall slightly on Wednesday after a flat session on Tuesday when most stocks traded below their fixing in continuous trade.
Analysts said, however, any falls were unlikely to be significant. They said the bourse should maintain its eight-week horizontal trend in the longer-term on the lack of fresh fundamental signals.
They said 16,000 or 15,600 should provide strong support for the market, currently at 16,245.2 points.
